name: Ahio
overview: Ahio was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, known specifically as the son of Elpaal. His identity is primarily recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:14, where he is listed among the genealogies of Benjamin. There are no additional notes or distinguishing events associated with him in the biblical record.
namesAndTitles: The name Ahio means '[my] brother is YHWH,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning that connects his identity to the Lord. This proper name, found in 1 Chronicles 8:14, is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries significance in its reference to the divine name.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Ahio was the son of Elpaal, as noted in 1 Chronicles 8:14. Beyond this, there are no further family relationships detailed in the biblical text regarding Ahio.
scriptureSignificance: Ahio's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, which serve to trace the heritage and lineage of God's chosen people. Though not associated with specific events or roles, his inclusion in the biblical genealogy underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving His covenant people through successive generations.
